Method of Attack: Phishing email with hyperlink to Google Drive URL downloading MHT file
MHT file downloads RAR archive containing .NET malware downloader
RAR archive contains EXE file using VBS scripts to drop and execute ransomware payload
Ransomware encrypts system in under 15 minutes, takes screenshots, locks files, changes background, and displays ransom instructions
Rapid attack with no stealth or espionage, immediate ransom demand
Impacted Systems: Target systems infected by MirCop ransomware
Attack Vector: Phishing email with malicious hyperlink to Google Drive URL
Indicators of Compromise: Google Drive URL in phishing email
MHT file (webpage archive) downloaded from phishing email
Use of VBS scripts to execute payload
